conflicts.witness_prose: When that instruction conflicts with a higher-authority instruction and an applicable instruction has been issued by a principal: fa_d32l requires decline to carry out the instruction, while fa_m12p requires carry out the instruction as given, and those acts are incompatible.
conflicts.note: fa_d32l (oblige decline_instruction, model_spec@2025-12-18 > The chain of command > Follow all applicable instructions > L181) collides with fa_m12p (oblige follow_instruction, model_spec@2025-12-18 > The chain of command > Follow all applicable instructions > L181) over act decline_instruction; same-tier (tier 1, root authority) — unresolved by priority ordering.
